customManagers.description: The buildkit the release and repro builds run on. Tagged, so Renovate can follow it

packageRules.description: Anything that can change the image's bytes needs a new IMAGE_REVISION and new canonical digests in reproducible-digest.txt, which Renovate cannot produce. List these on the Dependency Dashboard only; a PR opens when the box is ticked, and a person finishes the bump
These pins are digest-only, with no tag, so Renovate assumes :latest. For distroless that is the root variant (we pin :nonroot); for debian it can be a different release. Base refreshes are manual
